newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Australian prime minister arrives in Jakarta.
newsitem.headline: Australian prime minister arrives in Jakarta.

text.p: Australian Prime Minister John Howard arrived in Jakarta on Monday for his first official visit to Indonesia since coming to office six months ago.
He drove straight from Jakarta's Sukarno-Hatta international airport to Freedom Palace for a meeting with President Suharto.
While relations between the two neighbours have been sometimes rocky, Howard's visit is seen as boosting ties between them and emphasising his government's commitment to Asia.
He leaves for Japan early on Wednesday. The two-nation visit had earlier been postponed after his wife fell ill.
